description: This is a Java test class for the MainViewModel in an Android application, containing unit tests for the method 'fromCategoriesWithNotesCount' and a method to check for non-infrastructure related items.

classes.name: MainViewModelTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing MainViewModel's methods, especially 'fromCategoriesWithNotesCount' and 'containsNonInfrastructureRelatedItems'.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, retrieves the method 'fromCategoriesWithNotesCount' via reflection.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_nothing_expanded
methods.description: Tests the 'fromCategoriesWithNotesCount' method with no expanded categories, expecting a specific list of NavigationItems.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_Bar_expanded
methods.description: Tests the method with an expanded 'Bar' category, expecting a larger list with subcategories.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_invalid_expanded
methods.description: Tests the method with a non-existent category, expecting default behavior.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_subcategory_expanded
methods.description: Tests handling of expanded subcategories, which should be treated as unknown categories.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_only_deep_category_without_favorites
methods.description: Tests behavior with a deep category without favorites, expecting fallback to parent category.

methods.name: containsNonInfrastructureRelatedItems
methods.description: Tests the method that filters out infrastructure-related exceptions, verifying correct identification of relevant exceptions.
